column1: # Exact content-and-finding ratchet for KRO resource graphs, committed instances, and their
# Columns: count, repository-relative source path, evidence ID, severity/type, line range/digest.
# This is not an ignore file: scan-rgd-templates.sh runs every Trivy misconfiguration check without
# exclusions, then fails on any difference from these visible findings or canonical content digests.
# RGD-CONTENT covers the complete graph spec, including schema defaults, conditions, and iteration;
# INSTANCE-CONTENT covers every committed substitution input. Both avoid dependence on yq's YAML
# formatting. A removed finding leaves in the same change; a new finding is fixed, not baselined.
# Measured with Trivy v0.74.0 and the policies embedded in that binary. CI pins the binary on pull
# requests and direct main pushes; the gate rejects other versions and independent policy updates.
